name: whatsapp-mcp-desktop
description: Let Claude read and search your own WhatsApp. Read only by default; sending is off unless you turn it on. Everything stays on this computer.

tools.name: connect_whatsapp
tools.description: Open the QR page to link WhatsApp

tools.name: open_settings_page
tools.description: Open the settings page: connection, drop history, alerts

tools.name: status
tools.description: Is WhatsApp connected, how many messages are stored

tools.name: get_image
tools.description: Look at a picture from a message

tools.name: transcribe_voice
tools.description: Turn a voice note into text (with your Gemini or OpenAI key)

tools.name: watch_video
tools.description: Describe a video and its speech (with your Gemini key)

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the text inside a PDF or text file from a message

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a text message (off by default, turn on in settings)

tools.name: save_file
tools.description: Save a file from a message to Downloads

tools.name: save_files
tools.description: Save every file of a chat to Downloads at once
